MaPatriots akapedza mwaka wa2007 wenguva dzose aine rekodhi 16-0 yakakwana, achingova timu yechina munhoroondo yeligi kuenda isina kukundwa mumwaka wakajairwa, uye ndiyo yega kubva ligi yakawedzera hurongwa hwayo hwemwaka kumitambo gumi nematanhatu. HC Davos yakavambwa muna 1921. Muna 1923, Davos akapa Spengler Cup yekutanga, imwe yemakwikwi ekare mumitambo ichiri kutambwa.

HC Davos yaitungamirwa nemutsetse wemberi unozivikanwa se "The ni-storm" (German: Der ni-sturm) kubva 1933 kusvika 1950, waisanganisira Bibi Torriani, pamwe chete nehama Hans Cattini naFerdinand Cattini. Mutsetse wakapihwa zita rekupedzisira syllable (-ni) yemazita evatambi. Iyo ni-dutu yaionekwa semutsetse wepamusoro weHC Davos uye yeSwitzerland varume vehoki hockey timu kubva 1933 kusvika 1950. Munguva iyi, kirabhu yakakunda 18 Swiss Championship, uye matanhatu Spengler Cups.

Chikwata chakaiswa mu 1. Liga mu1990, imwe yenzvimbo dzakaderera munhoroondo yayo. Mushure mekutanga kutsva, kirabhu yakatamira kuSwiss League, uye makore maviri gare gare yakadzokera kuNL. Davos anga ari pakati pezvikwata zvakanakisa muligi kubvira, nemakwikwi eligi achangoburwa muna 2002, 2005, 2007, 2009, 2011, na2015.
